about_short_description.short_description: Encord is the AI native data Infrastructure company. We help teams curate, manage, and annotate the data needed to train and run AI

product.name: Annotate
product.description: A multimodal data annotation platform that supports images, video, audio, text, DICOM, and LiDAR with AI-assisted labeling and customizable workflows.

product.name: Index
product.description: A data management and curation platform to organize, search, and prioritize large-scale multimodal AI datasets securely.

product.name: Active
product.description: A model evaluation and active learning platform to monitor, validate, and improve AI model performance using data curation and label validation.

product.name: DICOM Annotation Tool
product.description: A specialized medical imaging annotation tool supporting 3D, multi-plane views, and advanced labeling for CT, MRI, and ultrasound data.

product.name: Physical AI Suite
product.description: A unified platform for ingesting, visualizing, annotating, and evaluating multimodal sensor data including LiDAR, radar, and camera streams for robotics and autonomous systems.

product.name: Labeling Services
product.description: Outsourced data labeling services connecting AI teams with specialized annotators to deliver high-quality labeled datasets with quality control.
